exec.rationale: exec(command, cwd, {onData, signal, timeout, env}) is Exec(ctx, command, cwd, BashOperationsExecOptions{OnData, Timeout *float64 seconds, Env []string}) (BashOperationsResult{ExitCode *int}, error): signal is ctx, a null exitCode is a nil pointer, an abort or timeout is the returned error.

async: An awaited Promise is a blocking Go call that returns the value or error; AbortSignal is the context.Context argument; no detached goroutine.
rationale: BashOperations is the extension.BashOperations interface; LocalShellOperations is the local implementation.
